senses.gloss: , read: תְּרוּנַק, or תְּרוּנְקֵס m. (θρίναξ) trident, fork, used as a tool in writing, prob. for levelling the paper (cmp. Lat. charta dentata).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:8">Kel. XVI, 8</cite> <he>תיק מכתב ות׳ תיק וכ׳</he> the case for the stylus and the trident, the case of &c.—[The corrupt. of our w. arose from a dittography of the next following word <he>תק</he> or <cite ref="V00481"><he>תיק</he></cite>,—which gave rise to the etymology <he>תרין־תק</he>.—Hai Gaon explains our w. with <he>המנק</he>.]
